name: inceleme-antrenoru
description: Practice finding the hidden bugs in AI-written code and explaining them the way an interviewer expects.

scripts.dev: npm run build:questions && npm run build:site-data && vite
scripts.build: npm run build:questions && npm run build:site-data && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir generated/ssr && node scripts/prerender.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run proof && npm run build
scripts.counter:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply kodprova-sayac --local --config functions/wrangler.local.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state
